notes_before.tpp_requirement_authorization: 2026-10-22 user: Approved: implement the TPP plan as written: --tpp-requirement on top of cf0825b8, TPP in biomass_C at the yeast-GEM value 1.2e-6 mmol/gDW, R1342 closed (not deleted), ThiL BLAST check, KO comparison included. No commit or push.
notes_before.tpp_requirement_evidence: KEGG REST link/yli/K00946 and link/sce/K00946 (thiL, thiamine-monophosphate kinase, EC 2.7.4.16) return no genes; link/yli/K00949 (thiamine pyrophosphokinase) returns yli:2911892 = YALI2_E01340g, the old locus tag of W29 YALI1E25443g in GCF_001761485.1 (read 2026-10-22). blastp of all 27 Swiss-Prot ThiL entries (release 2026_03) against the W29 proteome finds no hit at E of at most 1e-5 (best E = 0.006 over 27% of the query); the THI80 control P35202 finds YALI1E25443g at E = 1.8e-24 (model/reports/tpp_requirement_20261022/thil_blast_w29.csv).
notes_before.tpp_requirement_evidence_tier: verified on 2026-10-22: no KEGG K00946 assignment in yli (the CLIB122 genome) or sce, and no ThiL BLAST hit in W29. The THI80 control is a different protein family; it shows that the database and search work, not that a divergent ThiL would be found. Absence of a sequence homologue does not prove that no enzyme phosphorylates TMP. The yeast route, TMP to thiamine to TPP through THI80, is established/uncited.
notes_before.tpp_requirement_rationale: R1342 is gene-less and, once TPP is required, was the only route to TPP that bypasses THI80 (R752). It is closed, not deleted, so its equation and cross-references stay for review.

R1342.evidence: MetaNetX 4.5 reac_prop lists MNXR104907 with EC 2.7.4.16;2.7.4.9, while all of its cross-references are thiamine-phosphate kinase (Rhea 15913, KEGG R00617, MetaCyc THI-P-KIN-RXN, BiGG TMPK, SEED rxn00438 and rxn38718, SABIO 1007). ExPASy enzyme.dat (release of 28-Jan-2026): 2.7.4.9 is dTMP kinase, 2.7.4.16 is thiamine-phosphate kinase.
R1342.evidence_tier: verified on 2026-10-22 from the local MetaNetX 4.5 and ExPASy files
R1342.rationale: EC 2.7.4.9 belongs to thymidylate (dTMP) kinase; R1342 phosphorylates thiamine monophosphate, so only EC 2.7.4.16 fits. Every other cross-reference is kept.
